item.title: Officer killed, another injured in West Philadelphia shooting
item.description: Authorities identified the deceased officer as 40-year-old Shane Seiber, a 10-year veteran of the force.

item.title: Video shows Virginia police rescuing man from house fire

item.title: Christa Pike released from hospital after botched execution, attorneys say
item.description: Attorneys said Saturday that Christa Pike was released from the hospital and returned to prison more than a week after her botched execution.
